patch.value: Release coverage gate is below 100 percent and omits executable tooling

The baseline release gate passes because package thresholds are lines 91 branches 77 and functions 93 over index.ts only. Actual measured coverage is 93.40 percent lines 80.33 percent branches and 95.28 percent functions; no independent statements metric is reported, and executable TypeScript gates plus the JavaScript merge-driver helper are outside the measured production set. This is separate from the canonical CLI migration.

Define the complete production source inventory including executable tooling; eliminate or migrate the remaining JavaScript helper to erasable TypeScript; establish independently measured 100 percent statements branches functions and lines without ignore directives or artificial tests; add mutation or adversarial checks that prove the gate fails on an unexecuted source and each threshold regression; keep tests fast nonduplicative and behavior-focused; include the exact gate in release check and CI; document literal scope and results
pm-beads main d4f36b5 baseline release check with 115 tests
Run NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG=/dev/null npm run release:check and inspect the coverage table and package.json coverageGate sources thresholds; inspect scripts/prepare-merge-driver.mjs.
Release and CI fail unless every executable production source reaches genuine independent 100/100/100/100 coverage and all production code is TypeScript or Rust.

The current gate passes at 93.40 percent lines 80.33 percent branches and 95.28 percent functions over index.ts only with thresholds 91/77/93. It reports no statements metric and excludes executable tooling.
A green release check currently permits uncovered production behavior and cannot substantiate the mandatory four-dimensional coverage claim.

message: Track independent exact coverage and TypeScript blocker
